title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Stream]
description: The mountain trail ends here, opening into a wide area that provides a good place to rest.  Progress to the west ends with an exposure of several thousand feet.  You notice a wooden beam trellis which runs from this point up the side of the mountain to quite a distance above you.  On one side, a freshwater mountain stream tumbles out of an opening into a pool.

then.for: You push hard on the wooden dam slat and it slides closed.|It is already closed.

then.msg: Waiting for 'riding on the trellis'.  This may take around four and a half minutes.

then.for: riding on the trellis, crawls down the side of the mountain and comes to a clunky stop
